name: atlas-workflow
description: Atlas workflow plugin for bounded local Codex work.

interface.longDescription: Adds Atlas workflow, task, intake, office-hours, brainstorm, analyze, clarify, team, learning, design-review, worktree, and finish entrypoints as local plugin skills so `$atlas-workflow:cw`, `$atlas-workflow:task`, `$atlas-workflow:intake`, `$atlas-workflow:office-hours`, `$atlas-workflow:brainstorm`, `$atlas-workflow:analyze`, `$atlas-workflow:clarify`, `$atlas-workflow:team`, `$atlas-workflow:learn`, `$atlas-workflow:design-review`, `$atlas-workflow:worktree`, and `$atlas-workflow:finish` stay available even when custom slash prompts are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: 生成项目文档、workflow artifacts、交接材料和面向用户总结时，默认使用中文，除非用户明确要求其他语言
Use $atlas-workflow:task for bounded implementation or diagnosis
Use $atlas-workflow:clarify before execution when boundaries are unclear
